round1.evidence: Sources describe the ORGANIZED Pantazi beach between Agios Nikolaos and Agios Dimitrios, but no explicit facility evidence for the Agios Nikolaos village beach itself.
Only evidence is a 2025 municipal auction notice that a 500 sq.m. umbrella/sunbed concession space MAY be leased — no confirmation an operator actually runs sunbeds there.
No source about a Livadia beach in Messinia was found; all 'Livadia' results refer to Paros, Tilos, Astypalaia etc. (heavy name collision).
No beach-specific source found; only island-wide statements that Anafi's best beaches have 'πεντακάθαρα νερά και ειδυλλιακά τοπία χωρίς ξαπλώστρες' — generic, not attributable to this specific beach.

Antiparos.com describes Sifneiko/Sunset beach with only 'a children's playground nearby and stone benches' — no mention of sunbeds, umbrellas or a beach bar; other guides class it with the 'alternative' non-commercial beaches, but no explicit unorganized statement found.
Sources describe a small family beach with tamarisks and a taverna ~10m away; no explicit statement of sunbeds or a beach bar (name collides with Halkidiki/Lefkada Kalamitsi).
One source says the beach is not organized but a canteen (αναψυκτήριο) operates; another says a section has had sunbeds in recent years — conflicting, so not promoted.
Kythnos sources describe sand/pebbles and tamarisk shade in front of the settlement; no explicit mention of sunbeds or a beach bar (island-wide 'very few beaches are organized').
Sandy family beach near Loutra with shops at its edge; no explicit sunbed/umbrella or beach-bar evidence found.
Conflicting sources: some say no umbrellas/sunbeds (bring your own), others report a section with rentable sunbeds/taverna in recent years; main sandy isthmus stays free of sunbeds.
No beach-specific evidence found for Kipoi/Kipos Milos; Milos guides list other organized beaches (Fyriplaka, Provatas, Paleochori) but give no facilities info for this one.
Mykonos has two Agia Anna beaches; the sunbeds/beach-volley/diving-center evidence found refers to the Agia Anna next to Kalafatis, not clearly this beach near Chora — collision, not promoted.
Described as a quiet meltemi-exposed cove with a taverna; no clear explicit statement on sunbeds/beach bar found (one aggregator's attribute list is ambiguous).
Search evidence covers the main Chrysi Akti (organized with sunbeds/beach bars/windsurf centers), but nothing specific to the separate Agkali sub-beach — not promoted on adjacent-beach evidence.
Conflicting sources — one says umbrellas/sunbeds exist, another says 'no sunbeds and umbrellas, only quiet and a unique view'; visits are officially banned due to landslides.
Tiny (~30m) pebble beach at Kastro's old port with a restaurant, mini market and two fish tavernas adjacent; no explicit statement on sunbeds/umbrellas found.
No reliable source found for an Agkali beach on Tinos — search results collide with Agali in Evia/Folegandros; nothing beach-specific to this Tinos location.
Described only as a small picturesque beach near Chora good for afternoon swims; no source states sunbeds/umbrellas or a bar at this beach (heavy name collision with Stavros Crete/Chalkidiki).
Sources describe a popular sandy beach on Schinoussa but none explicitly mention sunbeds/umbrellas or a bar (heavy Psili Ammos name collision across islands).

astypalaia-island.gr describes it as quiet/peaceful with shade from big trees; no mention of sunbeds/bar, contrasted with 'more cosmopolitan and organized' Livadi, but not explicitly called unorganized.
No Karpathos-specific source found confirming facilities; the municipal all-beaches page does not list a Makrygialos, and search results collide with Makrygialos in Pieria (Central Macedonia).

Kastellorizo's only small pebble beach; mixed reports that the municipality placed a few sunbeds/umbrellas and of a swim platform with umbrellas, but the accounts are garbled and may refer to other spots on the islet.

Plakes is a slippery-rock swimming spot; the organized swimming area with sunbeds and a small taverna on Kastellorizo is on the Agios Georgios islet, not Plakes — no explicit statement about Plakes facilities.
Patmosweb lists Aspri without any facilities or organization mention; no source found stating sunbeds or a bar.
